summary_1line: At Karna’s urging, Duryodhana appoints Drona as commander of the Kaurava army, and the troops celebrate his formal investiture before battle.

image_candidates.scene_text: Before the assembled Kaurava kings and armies, Duryodhana ceremonially proclaims Drona as commander while warriors shout victory.
Drums thunder and conch shells blare as the aged warrior Drona is ritually invested with command amid banners and cheering soldiers.
Armored kings and chariots crowd around the venerable Drona standing in the center of the army as he prepares to lead them to battle.
